name: spike.skill
title_zh: 8 个技能一包拆，专治「装完吃灰」的精选集
tagline_zh: 不是凑数合集。每个技能都解决一个具体到能说出口的麻烦，装完当天就能用上至少一个，而不是躺在列表里占地方。
tagline_en: No filler. Each skill solves one concrete, nameable problem. Install today, use at least one today—not just.
why_zh: 按「使用频率 × 不可替代性」筛过，不是 GitHub 随手 star 的堆料。每个都自带明确边界。
why_en: Curated by usage frequency × irreplaceability, not random GitHub stars. Each skill knows its own boundaries and where to stop.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 8 个具体场景，不保证通用。若你的需求不在其中任一技能描述内，本包对你就是 8 个占位符。
limit_en: Covers exactly 8 specific scenarios, not general-purpose. If none match your need, it's just 8 placeholders. Read each README first; install only if.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 8-pack skill bundle, each one earns its keep
